die kleine Bude joggen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ohne nass zu
werden! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Sehr clever, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}'in evi devasa!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Büyük ev insanın
rahat nefes almasını
sağlar.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Düşününce{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} son zamanlarda
daha sakin ve havalı görünüyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}The ocean is so much fun, isn't it?
The wind feels really good here!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}El mar es una pasada, ¿a que sí?
¡Y qué brisa! ¡Me encanta cuando
te da en la cara al pasar corriendo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Cette pente, je la connais par cœur !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Je me suis mis à donner des noms
aux cailloux après l'avoir remontée
environ 100 000 fois, je crois.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Il mare ha un fascino particolare!
L'aria ha un odore diverso da
queste parti!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Okyanus çok eğlenceli, değil
mi? Buradaki rüzgâr da harika!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¿Qué tipo de cosas puedes vender
en {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Reciclaje Bártulos{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}? ¿Es cierto
que puedes llevarles de todo?
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Estoy pensando en llevarles
mi viej{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD02006F000200610002003000}} {{TAG:0005:000F:0000}},
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}On peut refiler tout et n'importe
quoi chez {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Revente & Retouches{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, pas
vrai ?
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Je vais essayer de leur fourguer
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:000F:0000}}, juste pour
voir, ha ha !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Cyrus {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}took care of me at Re-Tail
the other day! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}He is so cool!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Trickling sweat! Rugged hands! He's
a true master of his craft!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}And soooo manly! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Al {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}me atendió el otro día en
Reciclaje Bártulos! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Es un tío
como hay que ser!
Fui a venderle unas mancuernas que
tenía muertas de risa en casa, ¡y me
dio las gracias!{{TAG:0003:0004:}} ¡Qué enrollado!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'autre jour, j'ai eu affaire à {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Serge
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}à Revente & Retouches.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}La sueur qui perle sur le front, de
grosses pattes bien robustes...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Impossible de le prendre pour un
comptable !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Il a vraiment une classe folle,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Merino {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}è stato gentilissimo l'altro
giorno, quando sono andato nel suo
negozio, {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Ricicla e Ricrea{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
Quelle zampe ruvide e il sudore
sulla fronte fanno di lui
un vero artigiano!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Col suo lavoro, è come se si
allenasse tutti i giorni,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Björn {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}war mir 'ne Riesenhilfe in der
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fundgrube {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}neulich! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Er ist ein guter
Sportsfreund!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Der Kerl ist ein echter Champ in
Sachen Handwerkssport!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ich wäre bestimmt auch ein klasse
Handwerkssportler, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Cyrus{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} geçen gün Re-Tail'de benimle
ilgilendi! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Adam çok havalı!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ter
damlaları! Sert eller! İşinin gerçek
ustası!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Hem de çooook erkeksi! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}I get a weird feeling when I run into
someone near the station. I don't
know what it is.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Maybe I'm feeling guilty because I
haven't gone to see my mom in a 
while. {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Me da una sensación muy rara
al cruzarme con alguien cerca de
la estación, y no sé por qué será.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Tal vez me siento culpable porque
hace tiempo que no me acerco a
visitar a mi madre, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Le train, c'est comme une boîte de
chocolats... On ne sait jamais
vraiment ce qu'il y a dedans.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}La seule différence, c'est que ma
mère ne risque pas de surgir d'une
boîte de chocolats,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Quando incontro qualcuno vicino
alla stazione, provo sempre
una strana sensazione.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Forse mi sento solo in colpa perché
è da un secolo che non vado
a trovare mia madre, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ich hab immer so ein fieses Pochen
in meinem Schädel, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wenn ich am
Bahnhof bin.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Das ist bestimmt mein schlechtes
Gewissen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}weil ich meine Mama ewig
nicht besucht hab, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}İstasyonun yakınında birine rastlayınca
tuhaf hissediyorum. Neden bilmiyorum.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Belki annemi uzun zamandır görmeye
gitmediğim için suçluluk
duyuyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
Un muelle sigue ahí durante años,
¡resistiendo los envites del mar
con mucha tenacidad! ¡Eso mola!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Además trabajar en el mar es muy
duro, con lo que hay que ser fuerte,
como yo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}} ¿Y si me hiciera marino?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Ay, no, ni hablar, nooo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}¡Es que en alta mar no hay
gimnasios ni pistas en las que
correr a mi aire! ¡Ni me lo planteo!
FR:
À l'approche du ponton, le moins
qu'on puisse dire, c'est que ça sent
l'homme, le vrai.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}À moins que{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}À moins que
quelqu'un ne soit venu pêcher par ici
et ait oublié d'emmener son butin...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}I couldn't help but notice you're
near a police station. Did you do
something bad?!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}What? Me? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I've got no reason to
have a guilty conscience!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Police stations make me nervous
even when I'm on my best
behavior! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Vaya, pero si estás junto a la
comisaría. ¡¿No tienes miedo
de que te detengan?!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Que por qué lo digo? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oye, ¡que yo
no tengo nada que ocultar! ¡Era
simplemente una broma!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Las comisarías me ponen nervioso
incluso aunque no haya hecho nada
malo! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}No sé por qué, ¡pero es así!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
FR:
Je me demandais... {{TAG:0003:000F:}}On n'est pas loin
du poste de police, là...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} T'as fait
quelque chose de mal ?!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hein ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Moi ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Jamais de la vie !{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}} J'ai
la conscience hyper tranquille !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}À la limite, je ne serais pas surpris
si on m'arrêtait pour avoir de trop
gros biscotos !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Non posso fare a meno di notare
che sei vicino a una stazione
di polizia. Sei nei guai?
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Cosa? Io? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Guarda che la mia
coscienza è pulitissima!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Le stazioni di polizia mi rendono
sempre nervoso, anche se non ho
fatto nulla, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Karakolun yakınında olduğunu fark ettim.
Kötü bir şey mi yaptın?! {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ne? Ben mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Vicdan
azabı duyacak hiçbir şeyim
yok!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Karakollar, en uslu hâlimde bile
beni geriyor! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
After a nice jog, I like to have some
coffee at a coffee shop before
heading home.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Brewster{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} knows exactly what I like!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}I appreciate that kind of attention
to detail. {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
Tras salir a correr, me encanta
tomarme un buen café en una
cafetería antes de volver a casa.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Fígaro {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}sabe exactamente
lo que me gusta! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Me encanta que
den tan buen servicio, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
Après un bon jogging, j'aime bien
passer prendre un café avant de
rentrer à la base...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Robusto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} connaît mes goûts comme
personne.{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}Ça fait toujours plaisir
de se sentir spécial,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
Dopo una bella corsetta, mi fermo
sempre al bar a bere un caffè.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Bartolo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}sa esattamente come mi
piace. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Conosce benissimo le mie
ordinazioni, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
Nach 'nem harten Lauftraining
gönn ich mir 'ne schöne Tasse
Kaffee im Café.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Kofi {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}weiß genau, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wie ich meinen
Kaffee mag! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Darum geh ich auch
so gern zu ihm, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
Güzel bir koşudan sonra eve gitmeden
önce kafede kahve içmeyi severim.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Brewster{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ne sevdiğimi tam biliyor!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Bu detaycılığı takdir ediyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Being near the town hall certainly
reminds me{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If your mayor job gets too tough, I
can step in anytime.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}My first order of business would be
to get folks to exercise more. We
need more sports cred in this town!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ahora que estamos cerca
del ayuntamiento, se me acaba
de pasar algo por la cabeza{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si la cosa se te pusiera muy chunga,
no me importaría hacerme alcalde
yo y arreglarlo todo, ¿eh?
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Lo primero que haría sería obligar
a todos a hacer más ejercicio.
¡Estar sano ahorra muchos gastos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Puisqu'on se trouve vers la mairie,
je vais en profiter pour te faire une
proposition.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Si le boulot de maire est un
fardeau trop lourd pour tes frêles
épaules, je peux m'en charger !
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Avec moi, tu peux pas te tromper !
Ce serait bien le premier truc que
j'arriverais pas à porter, ha ha !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ah, il municipio{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se il tuo lavoro da sindaco diventa
troppo pesante, posso sostituirti
per qualche giorno, se vuoi!
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Per prima cosa, farei un'ordinanza
che obbliga ad allenarsi di più.
Abbiamo bisogno di campioni, qui!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Wann immer ich am Rathaus steh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
fällt mir ein, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass ich auch gern mal
Bürgermeister wär{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vielleicht übernehm ich irgendwann
den ganzen Laden hier, wenn es dir
zu viel wird!
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Und meine erste Maßnahme wäre
das tägliche Guten-Morgen-Training!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Denn Sport macht glücklich!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Und ein Bürgermeister will doch
glückliche Bürger haben, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Belediyenin yakınında olmak bana
bir şeyi hatırlattı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Başkanlık işi fazla
zorlaşırsa her an devralabilirim.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}İlk
işim herkesi daha çok egzersiz yaptırmak
olur. Bu kasabaya daha fazla spor
havası lazım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The area in front of the town hall is
a perfect spot for an exercise yard.
Seriously! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}You could even put in a basketball
court or a small soccer pitch{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}But {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Isabelle {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}will go Isabellistic if you
break a window!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La zona que hay frente al
ayuntamiento es un sitio perfecto
para una cancha deportiva, ¿eh?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Y no especifico más... Podría ser
una cancha de tenis, de baloncesto
o de lo que sea{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Pero {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Canela{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} seguro que se pondría
de un humor de perros si una pelota
perdida le rompiera una ventana!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le terrain qui fait face à la mairie
serait parfait pour faire du sport...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}On pourrait y installer un court de
tennis, voire un mini-terrain de
foot{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Faudra juste éviter de casser des
vitres si on ne veut pas subir la
colère de {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Marie{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'area davanti al municipio sarebbe
perfetta per costruire un palazzetto
dello sport, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Magari con un campo da basket
e uno da calcio{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Certo che {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Fuffi {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}andrebbe su tutte
le furie se le rompessimo
una finestra!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Der Platz vorm Rathaus ist doch
der perfekte Sportplatz, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Man könnte hier 'nen Basketballkorb
hinstellen oder Fußballtore{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aber wie ich {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Melinda {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}kenne,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
versteht sie null Spaß, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wenn mal
ein Fenster zu Bruch geht oder so.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Belediyenin önü egzersiz alanı
için mükemmel. Cidden! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}! {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Basketbol
sahası ya da küçük futbol alanı bile
koyabilirsin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ama cam kırarsan {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Isabelle{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
fena hâlde Isabelle'leşir!
